about: Sudafed Sinus 12 Hour Relief (pseudoephedrine), by brand name only and without paracetamol, is supplied four times from October to December 2025 to a 72-year-old.
Pseudoephedrine (Sudafed Sinus 12 Hour Relief) 120 mg is supplied three times from December 2025 to January 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Loratadine and a fluticasone nose spray are supplied for a stuffy nose. Neither is pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine.
